## Activity

This report records activity at North City Eye Clinic for May 2024. During the month, the clinic completed 600 captures. The capture total is presented as the activity measure for the reporting period and records the work completed at the site. Activity is reported separately from image quality and grading outcomes to support a clear review of site operations.

## Image quality

Image quality review identified 8 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 1.3 per cent. These figures show both the number of captures that could not be graded and the corresponding rate for the month. The results relate to the 600 captures recorded in the activity section.

## Grading

Grading identified 167 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This provides the reported midpoint measure for the time between capture and the grading outcome. The grading result is presented alongside the activity total and image quality measures for May 2024.
